label: 25 chp floor v1
definition: ercot 25 chp-floor-v1 (KEEPER): ercot 24 ct-drag-v1 base + chp_export_floor_measured (CHP steam-following grid floor = measured EIA-923 class CF x sector grid-delivery share, superseding the pooled CAMPD p2 minimum) + the rule-#13 benchmark fix (bench-side BTM now measured-input: 923 class total x chp_btm_pct, never the model's own dispatch — the old circular bench could never fail C1 for CHP classes and drifted ~19 TWh between identical solves). CC_CHP passes C1 every year (2023 -1.22 / 2024 +0.81 / 2025 +0.07 TWh); NOT-YET at hard 2/1: C1 CC_REGULAR 2023 -8.56 TWh (root cause quantified: ~4.1 TWh missing nodal/GTC curtailment + ~3.7 TWh 923-vs-930 gas basis inconsistency landing on the marginal class) and C2 gas 2025 -2.8% (preliminary-923 vintage gap, improved from -3.2%). C3b 2024 newly passes (NRMSE 0.199).
